package_artifacts.integration: src/pd/backoff.rs: constructor normalization, checker replacement, exponential wait/budget, warning cadence/name/attempt, deferred reset, context metadata, source failpoint probe; contextual cancellation error supplied by a future using existing native ownership primitives.

src/pd/backoff_tests.rs: original TestBackoffer and TestBackofferWithLog assertions, isolated logger adapter and paused-time tests; original race/goleak run uses unchanged source with scoped failpoint instrumentation.
src/pd/backoff.rs: Retry and WithConfig, phase-based ticker with skipped missed ticks, final failure wait, last-error cancellation and zero-attempt/invalid-interval behavior.

package_variants.native_failpoint_build: Existing fail dependency, test/dev failpoints feature; production feature-off eval remains inactive.

dependency_decisions.native: An owning context-done future yields the existing native Error unchanged. Backoffer returns that context error; interval retry preserves the last operation error. Operations still run before cancellation checks, and are not interrupted by this package. Dropping exec resets mutable state and releases all local timer/closure resources.

Reuse immutable type-keyed TraceContext and Arc<tokio::sync::Mutex<Backoffer>>. Optional absent context and nil backoffer map to None. Derivation preserves trace/other values and Arc identity without mutating the parent; no duplicate context implementation.

Lazily initialize and reuse one pinned Tokio Sleep for exponential waits. Fixed retry uses one reusable Sleep and Go runtime ticker phase arithmetic without Tokio Interval's five-millisecond burst tolerance. Duration::ZERO total is unbounded; negative durations/counts have no unsigned representation. Saturating doubling prevents Rust overflow.

Static typed Rust function name replaces Go runtime reflection; Rust closure/function-pointer names follow Rust type naming. Same warning text, fn-name/retry-time/error fields and cadence use existing log facade. Isolated test logger avoids process-global interference.
Preserve owned native error variants and sources; no conversion to strings or invented universal retry error. Rust does not add Go stack wrappers.

All five source support files inventoried; this package owns no worker, and timer/operation drop tests verify resource release. Original unchanged source runs under Go race/goleak with failpoint enable/disable. Linux execution is not claimed.
